title: Welcome to HuLib! 💙
p1: Your first story has been approved! 🎉 You’re officially a Huber — a “living book” for others to discover, listen to, and connect with.
p2: From now on, your future stories will be published as a Huber.
p3: Set up your availability so Libers can book a free 30-minute conversation with you. Even 30 minutes a week can help someone feel less alone on a similar journey. 💙 Thank you for becoming part of HuLib!
